subject.title: Dashboard: chart widgets (line, bar, area, sparkline, gauge)

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor line, bar, area, sparkline, and gauge as first-party modular dashboard builtins after the dashboard foundation lands?
rationale: The request is clear, but it commits OpenClaw to bundled widget and data-shape contracts on top of still-unmerged dashboard infrastructure.

options.title: Keep As Roadmap Builtins
options.body: Keep this issue open and implement chart builtins after the dashboard schema, binding resolver, and renderer surface are accepted.

options.title: Prove Externally First
options.body: Ask charting to ship first as custom widgets or a ClawHub/plugin package if maintainers want fewer bundled builtins.

options.title: Defer Charting
options.body: Leave trend visualization to exports or custom widgets until maintainers revisit dashboard builtin scope.

recommendation.title: Keep As Roadmap Builtins
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and implement chart builtins after the dashboard schema, binding resolver, and renderer surface are accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main routing signal is the recently merged Control UI plugin-tab seam that this dashboard work extends.
